subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who studies fossils.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Palaeontologist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Palaeontologist"** refers to a person who studies fossils to understand the history of life on Earth and ancient organisms. (जीवाश्म वैज्ञानिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The palaeontologist discovered dinosaur fossils during the excavation.
 
 
• Fossils are the preserved remains or impressions of organisms from the past, found in rocks and sediment.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Palaeontologist**.
